title: Compatibility equations for the affine vector-bundle chart
statement: The affine relative-spectrum chart for the symmetric algebra is compatible with the base projection and sends the zero section to the spectrum of the augmentation.

source.place: The affine chart and zero-section compatibility clauses.

proof.text: The under-category triangle of the counit algebra isomorphism, together with the section-map scalar law, gives the ring equation for the projection. Contravariant Spec functoriality and naturality of toSpecΓ give the first chart equation. For the zero-section equation, apply the concrete structure-algebra functor to its fully faithful preimage definition, evaluate on sections, and cancel the counit and its inverse. This identifies zero-section pullback with the augmentation. Compose with sectionMap, use augmentation_spec to identify it with SymmetricAlgebra.algebraMapInv, and apply Spec and toSpecΓ naturality. No invertibility of sectionMap is required for these equations; the affine comparison remains necessary to construct the quasi-coherent symmetric algebra and prove chart invertibility in the parent.

proof_origin.place: Scalar compatibility of the relative-spectrum algebra identification and augmentation pullback under the fully faithful structure-algebra functor.

theorem affineChart_equations (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S] (d : ℕ) (F : S.Modules)
    [F.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank d] (U : S.affineOpens) :
    (affineChart S d F U ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (S.presheaf.obj (op U.1))
        (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.sections F (op U.1)))) ≫ U.2.isoSpec.inv = (π S d F) ∣_ U.1) ∧
    (zeroRestricted S d F U.1 ≫ affineChart S d F U =
      U.2.isoSpec.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (SymmetricAlgebra.algebraMapInv (R := S.presheaf.obj (op U.1))
          (M := F.val.obj (op U.1))).toRingHom))
